500.body: Google announced Gemini 4 Carbon, a new frontier AI model that arrives just two weeks after Gemini 4 Argon reached the Gemini app.In a blog post published Oct. 28, Koray Kavukcuoglu, SVP at Google DeepMind, the company’s frontier AI lab, called Carbon Google’s strongest model yet. (Kavukcuoglu is leading Google DeepMind now that former CEO Demis Hassabis has stepped aside.) The post points to cybersecurity and long-horizon tasks, meaning complicated jobs that take many steps or run for a long time, as Carbon’s biggest strengths. Carbon and Meta’s Muse Wonder Full are both flagged on the leaderboard as having no publicly available API, so they can’t yet be used outside their companies’ own access programs.Gemini 4 Carbon: Safety and safeguardsGoogle says Carbon uses the same safety system as Argon, which includes monitoring the model’s reasoning, and adds more work on alignment, or keeping the model behaving as intended.

500.summary: According to Google, Gemini 4 Carbon delivers leading performance in detecting and exploiting computer vulnerabilities and generating software patches.
500.body: According to Google, Gemini 4 Carbon delivers leading performance in detecting and exploiting computer vulnerabilities and generating software patches. The group also said its new model produces secure code with a success rate more than twice that of Gemini 4 Argon, based on its internal evaluations. These improvements are intended to meet the needs of companies and cybersecurity specialists, while enabling the execution of complex software development projects requiring multiple steps and continuous work over extended periods.Google nevertheless plans an initial rollout limited to IT defense specialists participating in its Fairwind program, in order to continue evaluating the model's security mechanisms. Commercially, Gemini 4 Carbon retains Gemini 4 Argon's pricing, at $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens.

500.title: Google unveils Gemini 4 Carbon, its strongest AI model yet
500.summary: Google unveiled Gemini 4 Carbon on Wednesday, its newest artificial intelligence (AI) model, saying it delivers major improvements in coding, autonomous agent tasks, and cybersecurity defense.
500.body: Google unveiled Gemini 4 Carbon on Wednesday, its newest artificial intelligence (AI) model, saying it delivers major improvements in coding, autonomous agent tasks, and cybersecurity defense. In a blog post, Google called Carbon its most powerful frontier model, citing state-of-the-art cybersecurity and long-horizon capabilities and the ability to handle multi-step tasks over extended periods. Google attributed the rapid release timeline to its researchers and AI models “working hand in hand to advance capabilities faster.” The company claimed that Gemini 4 Carbon ranks first on the updated version 5.0 of the Artificial Intelligence Index, an independent ranking of AI models, with a score of 59. Google said Gemini 4 Carbon will first become available to cybersecurity defenders this week before rolling out more broadly to developers, businesses and consumers.
